env BOLERO_MODULE=off

# bolero help shows overview.
bolero help
stdout 'Bolero is a tool'
stdout 'bug.*start a bug report'

# bolero help bug shows usage for bug
bolero help bug
stdout 'usage: bolero bug'
stdout 'bug report'

# bolero bug help is an error (bug takes no arguments)
! bolero bug help
stderr 'bug takes no arguments'

# bolero help mod shows mod subcommands
bolero help mod
stdout 'bolero mod <command>'
stdout tidy

# bolero help mod tidy explains tidy
bolero help mod tidy
stdout 'usage: bolero mod tidy'

# bolero mod help tidy does too
bolero mod help tidy
stdout 'usage: bolero mod tidy'

# bolero mod --help doesn't print help but at least suggests it.
! bolero mod --help
stderr 'Run ''bolero help mod'' for usage.'

# Earlier versions of Go printed the same as 'go -h' here.
# Also make sure we print the short help line.
! bolero vet -h
stderr 'usage: bolero vet .*'
stderr 'Run ''bolero help vet'' for details.'
stderr 'Run ''bolero tool vet help'' for a full list of flags and analyzers.'
stderr 'Run ''bolero tool vet -help'' for an overview.'

# Earlier versions of Go printed a large document here, instead of these two
# lines.
! bolero test -h
stderr 'usage: bolero test'
stderr 'Run ''bolero help test'' and ''bolero help testflag'' for details.'

# bolero help get shows usage for get
bolero help get
stdout 'usage: bolero get'
stdout 'specific module versions'
